title: Influence of ultrafast laser processing on amorphous structures – based on molecular dynamics simulation
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38888-38897
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06905F, Paper

Shijia Liu, Jiaqi Liu, Jialin Liu, Jiuye Chen
Molecular dynamics simulations of ultrafast laser processing show alloy nucleation and growth in 10 nanoseconds, with rapid energy deposition shortening phase transformation and higher temperatures reducing the amorphous phase.
